newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON POUND OTAGO 60-34.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON POUND OTAGO 60-34.

text.p: The Wellington Hurricanes scored more than 50 points for the second week in a row by beating the Otago Highlanders 60-34 in a Super 12 match on Saturday.
In a 14-try thriller, Wellington dominated and took advantage of numerous Otago errors to score a stream of runaway tries that helped them build up a 38-point lead.
A late burst by the visitors in the second half, when they narrowed the gap from 41-3 to 41-27 in a 15-minute spell of four tries, could only ease the pain of the inevitable loss.
Otago have yet to win an away game in this year's Super 12 championship, while Wellington's victory followed their 59-30 thrashing of the Free State at the same ground a week ago.

All Black fullback Christian Cullen stood out as usual in the Hurricanes' ranks, running in a cheeky try from a set piece penalty in front of the posts to add to his haul of six conversion kicks and one penalty goal.
Tana Umaga scored three of Wellington's nine tries, with Jason O'Halloran and Alex Telea sprinting home with two each.
The game was peppered with mistakes and injuries on both sides as well as tries.

The Hurricanes are set to be without key winger and playmaker Alama Ieremia for a few weeks with a suspected broken collarbone, while lock forward and key lineout man Mark Cooksley is also likely to miss three or four weeks with neck and shoulder damage.
Highlander Jeff Wilson was stretchered off at the same time as his All Black pack mate Cooksley with a severe concussion.

Wellington Hurricanes: 15-Christian Cullen, 14-Tana Umaga (Jarrod Cunningham), 13-Alama Ieremia, 12-Jason O'Halloran, 11-Alex Telea, 10-Stephen Bachop, 9-Richard Jarman, 8-Karl Williams, 7-Martin Leslie, 6-Chresten Davis, 5-Mark Cooksley (20-Filo Tiatia), 4-Mike Russell, 3-Phil Coffin (21-Bill Cavubati), 2-Norm Hewitt, 1-Mark Allen (captain).

Otago Highlanders: 15-Matthew Carrington, 14-Jeff Wilson (16-John Leslie), 13-Romi Ropati, 12-To'o Vaega (Kupu Vanisi), 11-Manasa Bari (17-Brett McCormack), 10-Tony Brown, 9-Stu Forster, 8-Taine Randell (captain), 7-Josh Kronfeld (21-Ace Tiatia), 6-Isitolo Maka, 5-John Blaikie, 4-Steve Gordon, 3-Nick Moore (20-Kees Meeuws), 2-Anton Oliver, 1-Carl Hoeft.
